system.history:
A trained emergency responder carrying basic medical gear and accustomed to unstable scenes.

Scene use: Stabilizes civilians, reports injuries, identifies unusual symptoms, or directs heroes toward the most urgent rescue.
system.personality: Calm, practical, and focused on triage. Cooperates with heroes who make the scene safer and challenges anyone who creates new hazards.
system.distinguishingFeatures: High-visibility uniform, medical bag, gloves, radio, and emergency identification.

system.description: A close shove used only when escape or a patient's safety demands it.
